content: I/O Hardware Abstraction might have sub-structures Depending on the complexity of an ECU, the I/O Hardware Abstraction might have sub-structures. In this case the I/O Hardware Abstraction Layer is de- scribed by several EcuAbstractionSwComponentType s on M1.
